ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (>95% dark surface) with sparse, localized high-intensity (white) clusters occurring as punctate marks and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes. Vertical linear streaks present on the mid-medial region of the left lobe. Two distinct circular white spots on the central-lateral region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a sharp interior angle and clear separation between the left and right fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge. Notable irregular indentations present on the inner margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit an upward and lateral sweep. The trailing edge follows a generally concave path towards the tips, terminating in jagged, encrusted points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant three-dimensional high-contrast clusters (barnacles) at both lateral fluke tips. Two isolated circular white scars visible on the right lobe interior.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel vertical high-intensity linear marks located on the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the peduncle and the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive acorn barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes; visible white linear scarring on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral margins of the fluke are significantly thickened and irregular due to concentrated biological encrustation.
